name: Weight-12 Frobenius-paired cyclic GB on Z_341

provenance.construction: Cyclic generalized-bicycle code over Z_341: H_X=[circ(a)|circ(b)], H_Z=[circ(b)^T|circ(a)^T], with a={0,11,4,128,74,322} (weight 6, invariant under j->32j mod 341: fixed points 0, 11 and pair-orbits {4,128}, {74,322}) and b=a(x^8)={0,1,32,88,189,251}, a shifted Frobenius image with the same zero set. Shared divisor (x+1) times four full-order decics of x^341-1 (degree 41), so k=82; both check weights 12. Found by exhaustive enumeration of all 987,350 symmetric weight-6 words with exact zero sets in GF(1024) (433 equivalence classes), RIS-screened and laddered to 10,000,000 trials per side.
